actor: Leading-edge foundry fab-operations and ramp-engineering organization
job: Converting the raised US$60-64B capital plan into installed 2nm tool capacity and climbing wafer starts across the new fab phases.
outcome: Quarter-over-quarter 2nm wafer output growth steep enough to lift the node from 3% toward a fifth of wafer revenue.
motivation: Q3 guidance was publicly staked on the steep 2nm ramp, and the enlarged capex only pays back if leading-edge output scales fast.

task.who: fab construction, equipment-installation, and yield-ramp engineering teams at the 2nm sites
task.what: install litho and process tools and raise 2nm wafer starts
task.where: the new 2nm fab phases in Hsinchu and Kaohsiung
task.why: guidance and the US$60-64B capex plan assume a steep node ramp
task.how: phased cleanroom buildouts, EUV tool installs, and yield-learning cycles

actor: AI-accelerator silicon program lead at a fabless GPU/accelerator designer
job: Taping out next-generation AI accelerator dies on the 2nm node and locking multi-quarter wafer-supply agreements for volume production.
outcome: High-volume 2nm accelerator orders in production during the ramp window, filling the node's revenue mix.
motivation: Accelerator demand is rationed by supply, so securing leading-edge wafer allocation ahead of rivals decides datacenter market share.

task.who: the accelerator program's physical-design, foundry-interface, and supply-planning teams
task.what: tape out 2nm accelerator dies and commit wafer allocations
task.where: joint foundry-customer design-in and capacity-booking processes
task.why: supply-rationed demand makes early 2nm allocation a competitive weapon
task.how: 2nm PDK-based tapeouts plus prepaid long-term wafer agreements

actor: Flagship smartphone SoC design team at a major mobile-silicon customer
job: Qualifying flagship application processors and on-device NPU blocks on 2nm for the next annual handset cycle.
outcome: Volume 2nm smartphone-silicon production orders landing inside the ramp window, broadening the node's revenue base beyond AI accelerators.
motivation: Annual flagship launch cadence forces adoption of the best available node for performance-per-watt and NPU feature claims.

task.who: the SoC vendor's silicon-engineering and foundry-qualification teams
task.what: qualify and volume-order flagship SoCs on the 2nm node
task.where: foundry risk-production and qualification lots at the 2nm fabs
task.why: the yearly flagship cycle demands the leading node's efficiency gains
task.how: qualification vehicles, risk-production lots, then mass-production wafer bookings
